text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert PDR-9312 fired for synthetic check 'canary-eu3' — failing 5xx rate 28% over threshold (window=5m). Trigger=canary-runner.eu-west-3. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/synth-canary-failure

Mei Chen: acked PDR-9312 — I'm oncall, looking. Can someone grab prober logs (eu3-prober-7)?

Tomas Alvarez: grabbing logs now, looks like repeated 502s from target collector (collector-eu3-03). snippet:

```
2026-03-15T01:05:32Z eu3-prober-7 probe=canary-eu3 status=502 target=collector-eu3-03 latency_ms=12
2026-03-15T01:05:33Z eu3-prober-7 probe=canary-eu3 status=502 target=collector-eu3-03 trace_id=xyz
2026-03-15T01:06:01Z eu3-prober-7 probe=canary-eu3 status=200 target=collector-eu3-03 latency_ms=9
2026-03-15T01:06:34Z eu3-prober-7 probe=canary-eu3 status=502 target=collector-eu3-03 latency_ms=45
```

Mei Chen: thanks. I'm going to restart prober agent on eu3-prober-7 (svc/prober restart).

incident-bot: PagerDuty: PDR-9312 acknowledged by Mei Chen. Next escalation to L2 in 5m if not resolved.

Ben Ortiz: I see elevated 5xx from collector-eu3-03 in our metrics (increase ~3x). Spans show nginx upstream returning 502 -> backend pool. Tagging @eng-infra to check pooling/health.

Carla Singh: there's a minor deploy to collector-eu3 around 00:58 UTC (rollout id r-20260315-3). Could be warmup/connection churn. No alerts in deploy's log, but healthcheck flaps reported.

Mei Chen: prober restart done — agent reports steady 200 for a couple probes but occasional 502s still. Running a quick curl to backend to see behaviour:

```
$ curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}s" https://collector-eu3-03.internal/health
200 0.012s
$ curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}s" https://collector-eu3-03.internal/api/ingest
502 0.045s
```

Tomas Alvarez: applying `strace` on the upstream process — seeing a backlog of small connections and occasional short-lived ECONNRESET from the DB proxy. Possible connection pool exhaustion.

Ben Ortiz: temporary mitigation: increasing collector pod replica count by +2 for eu3-> applied HPA override for 10m. Also opened a temporary route to fallback-collector-eu (lighter weight) for canary traffic.

incident-bot: Action note: temporary route and replica bump applied by Ben Ortiz. Suppressing duplicate pages for PDR-9312 for 10 minutes to avoid alert fatigue.

Mei Chen: verifying customer impact — dashboards show no increase in 5xx from customer-facing endpoints; this looks isolated to synthetic probes and internal ingest path. I'll mark impact as "none detected" for customer-facing services but keep monitoring.

Carla Singh: I'll keep an eye on rollout logs and healthchecks for the next 20m. If collector pods show OOM or crashloops, we'll revert the deploy and run full db-proxy trace.

Mei Chen: handoff note for next on-call window — Raj, I'll transfer the incident to you once I rotate out in 25m. Current status: partial mitigation applied (replica bump + fallback route), probe errors reduced to ~3% but sporadic 502s persist. No customer impact observed.

Raj Patel: ack — I'll take over at 02:00 UTC. Main actions on my list: (1) monitor canary rate for next 30m, (2) coordinate with eng-infra for connection-pool tuning, (3) rollback collector deploy if errors increase.

Ben Ortiz: also suggest adding a short-lived sticky-ack in PD so the oncoming shift doesn't get paged repeatedly while we're in mitigation.

PagerDuty Bot: PDR-9312 suppression applied (duration=10m) by incident-bot automation. Escalation paused.

Mei Chen: leaving a short runbook note: restart prober -> if errors persist, bump collector replicas and switch canary to fallback-collector -> if still failing, rollback collector deploy -> escalate to infra with db-proxy traces.

Tomas Alvarez: adding (logs + strace + curl outputs) to the incident thread for postmortem.

incident-bot: PDR-9312 status update: reduced alert rate, no customer-facing degradation observed. If the metric stays below threshold for 30m, this alert will be auto-resolved.

Raj Patel: taking ownership now. Mei, ping me on Slack if anything spikes. I'll keep the thread updated.

Mei Chen: thanks — handing off to Raj, signing out for rotation. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

incident-bot: PDR-9312 auto-resolved at 7388890199 (metric window cleared). Closing thread.
